info.title: Port_Access_Auth_Configuration
info.description: RESTful interface for AOS-CX switch software

authentication_method.description:
Reference Resource: [Port_Access_Auth_Configuration](#/Port_Access_Auth_Configuration)
Authentication method specific port-access configurations on this interface.

cached_reauth_enable.description: Enables cached re-authentication on this port.

cached_reauth_period.description: Time in seconds, during which cached re-authentication is allowed on the port.

canned_eap_success_enable.description: Allow the switch to send a canned EAP success packet to the supplicant to indicate a successful authentication when:  1. The authentication fails due to a RADIUS server reject, but the port on which the client on-boarded has a reject-role configured. 2. The authentication fails due to a RADIUS server timeout, but the port on which the client on-boarded has a critical-role configured.

discovery_period.description: Time period(in seconds) to wait before an EAPOL request identity frame re-transmission on an 802.1X enabled port with no authenticated client. Applicable for 802.1X only.

eapol_timeout.description: Time period(in seconds) to wait for a response from a client before retransmitting an EAPOL PDU. If the value is not set the time period is calculated as per RFC 2988. Applicable for 802.1X only.

initial_auth_response_timeout.description: Time period(in seconds) to wait for the first EAPoL frame from a client before deeming the client to be incapable of 802.1X and start authentication using the next configured authentication method, if any. Applicable for 802.1X only. If not set, the next configured authentication method is attempted only after the authentication cycle of the current method is complete.

macsec_enable.description: Enable MACsec via EAP for 802.1X authenticator.

max_requests.description: Number of EAPOL requests to supplicant before authentication fails. Applicable for 802.1X only.

max_retries.description: Number of authentication attempts before authentication fails.

mka_cak_length.description: The length (in bytes) of the Connectivity Association Key (CAK) to derive for EAP MACsec.  `16`: Generate a 16 byte CAK.  `32`: Generate a 32 byte CAK.

config.description: User configured persona enum limited to access - access port - default uplink - uplink port as defined in ports.yaml custom - user defined custom value

custom.description: Custom persona value that user can input when config is custom

mode.description: Persona mode: attach - Row config is applied and follows the config          of its persona copy   - Row config is applied once

quiet_period.description: Time period(in seconds) to wait before processing an authentication request from a client that failed authentication.

radius_server_group.description: RADIUS server group to use for authentication. When not set, the RADIUS server group configured for the authentication method at the system level is used.

reauth_enable.description: Enables periodic re-authentication on this port.

reauth_period.description: Time period(in seconds) to enforce periodic re-authentication of clients.

parameters.name: Interface.name
parameters.description:
Reference Resource: [Port](#/Port)
The port name. For non-bonded ports, the port name is the same as the associated interface name. The name must otherwise be unique across all ports and interfaces of the system.

parameters.name: attributes
parameters.description: Columns to display.

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description: Depth to traverse.

parameters.name: selector
parameters.description: Select configuration, status and/or statistics. Default is all categories.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter rows by attribute values.  Format: attribute:value

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Count the number of rows found.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Entity-tag value for representation comparison (see RFC 7232 - Conditional Requests - section 3.2)
